scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @ai-content-os/api
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @ai-content-os/worker
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @ai-content-os/shared && npm run build -w @ai-content-os/config && npm run build -w @ai-content-os/contracts && npm run build -w @ai-content-os/integrations && npm run build -w @ai-content-os/database && npm run build -w @ai-content-os/testing
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @ai-content-os/api && npm run build -w @ai-content-os/web && npm run build -w @ai-content-os/worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
